title: Comet
tagline: Comet, is a browser extension that uses the news in addition to pricing data to help you make those once in a lifetime trades. Funds are stored in a staking pool
description:
Browser extension that uses sentiment analysis to provide more insight on whether or not you should buy a crypto asset. A staking pool is used to pool buying power so that the gains can be smartly reinvested.

More detail can be found in the presentation directory.
